name: brce-ledger
detail: No executable BRCE ledger/receipt adapter exists at the subject SHA; docs/integrations/BRCE_RECEIPT_ADAPTER_V0_1.md is a specification with Implementation standing NOT_CLAIMED. No ledger of DO-class actions with durable receipt digests can be produced, so the zero-unreceipted-actuation court (AC-08) cannot be evaluated and F-05 cannot be discharged.

execution.command: git archive f3b01d77909ef37f1a1775fe2a3ed88ddc54d030 | tar -x -C tree && (cd tree && sh probe.sh)
execution.probe_source:
#!/bin/sh
# BRCE ledger capability probe over an extracted affidavit subject tree (cwd).
# Exits 0 iff executable (non-doc) code implementing a BRCE ledger/receipt adapter exists.
hits=$(grep -rIl -i -E 'brce|consequence_id|brce-actuation|unreceipted' --include='*.rs' --include='*.py' --include='*.sh' --include='*.ts' --include='*.js' --include='*.ex' --include='*.exs' --include='*.toml' . 2>/dev/null)
echo "executable_brce_hits:"; echo "$hits"
echo "doc_brce_hits:"; grep -rIl -i 'brce' --include='*.md' . | sort
echo "adapter_claim_status:"; grep -n -E 'NOT_CLAIMED|No BRCE runtime implementation' docs/integrations/BRCE_RECEIPT_ADAPTER_V0_1.md
[ -n "$hits" ] && exit 0 || exit 3
execution.exit_meaning: 3 = zero executable (non-markdown) files reference BRCE; 0 would mean an implementation candidate exists
